question: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules which contain the Chlorine element.
evidence: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(label = '+' and element = 'cl'), COUNT(molecule_id)) as percentage
clarification: Count each distinct molecule_id only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'cl' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
gold0: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'cl' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) * 100 / COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

d.request: Calculate the percentage of carcinogenic molecules (label = '+') that contain the Chlorine element (element = 'cl'), counting each distinct molecule_id only once, where the percentage is the number of distinct carcinogenic molecules containing chlorine divided by the total number of distinct molecule_ids.
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

b.request: Interpret the percentage as the number of distinct carcinogenic (label = '+') molecules containing at least one Chlorine atom (element = 'cl'), divided by the count of distinct molecule_ids, times 100, with each molecule_id counted only once
b.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN m.molecule_id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage FROM molecule m INNER JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl'
